PowerShell($pids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach \($p in $pids\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "Detenido PID $p" } catch { "No se pudo detener PID $p" } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $still = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($still\) { "AUN ACTIVO: " + \($still.OwningProcess -join ', '\) } else { "Puerto 5000 LIBRE" })

PowerShell($ok=$false; for\($i=0;$i -lt 15;$i++\){ Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; if\(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\){$ok=$true;break} }; if\($ok\){ try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5000/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "OK - HTTP " + $r.StatusCode + " \(" + $r.Content.Length + " bytes\)" } catch { "Puerto abierto pero HTTP fallo: " + $_.Exception.Message } } else { "Puerto 5000 no abrio tras 15s" })
